## Log

The purpose of this script is to evaluate and compare revised BayWatch monitoring locations provided by Phil Maxwell from Baywatch. Compare revised sites to monitoring locations from FDEP WINS downloaded by Ryann Rossi. Can I get any metadata for Stations-Station Info.csv? Have 68 obs by 16 variables.

2026-10-31 Synced revised locations with locations and bays from script 04 Do same selection and counting as I did using bw_2023 stations1 in script 04 repeat selection and counting again, but include bay variable to see if that count matches linked micromap 5 number summary stats

```{r data}
rev_station_ds1 <- read_csv("data/Stations-Station Info Export.csv")
names(rev_station_ds1)
head(rev_station_ds1)
rev_station_ds1 <- clean_names(rev_station_ds1)
# spec(np_ds1)
# names(np_ds1)



# filter(dg_sf1, (!is.na(log_n2o))

summary(rev_station_ds1$latitude) #returns no NA
summary(rev_station_ds1$longitude) #returns no NA

unique(rev_station_ds1$number)
distinct(rev_station_ds1,win_location_id) %>%  dplyr::arrange(., win_location_id) %>% print(n=Inf)
# 68 distinct win_location_id entries
distinct(rev_station_ds1, number) %>% dplyr::arrange(., number) %>% print(n=Inf)
# 130 distinct number entries


```

## Create SF object

Revised locations outside of sf_bbl2 polygon, which comes from script 05, include points in Lakes Powell, Lullwater, and Martin.

```{r, create_sf}
# create sf object
coords <- data.frame(longitude  = rev_station_ds1$longitude, latitude = rev_station_ds1$latitude)
head(coords)

# See Marc Weber workshop above about Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS)

rev_station_sf1 <- st_as_sf(rev_station_ds1, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs =4269) %>% st_transform((5070))

class(rev_station_sf1)

st_crs(rev_station_sf1) == st_crs(sf_bbl2)
st_crs(sf_bbl2)
rev_station_sf1 <- rev_station_sf1 %>% st_transform(3087)
st_crs(rev_station_sf1) == st_crs(sf_bbl2)

mapview(rev_station_sf1) + mapview(sf_bbl2)


# mapview(hab_sf1, zcol = "Depth", cex = "Depth", alpha.regions = .8, legend = TRUE, popup = popupTable(hab_sf1, zcol = c("Depth", "Site"))) + mapview(bigbend_seagrass)

# index more spatially extensive sf object against small spatial extent results in a clip
# now have 53 entries
rev_station_sf2 <- rev_station_sf1[sf_bbl2, ]

```

## Sync Maps

```{r sync_maps}
# I believe my linked micromaps are based on 50 stations
rev1 <- mapview(rev_station_sf2, col.regions = "magenta")
locations_bays <- mapview(bw_2023_locationsbays2, col.regions = "green")

sync(rev1, locations_bays, ncol = 1)
```

## Compare Coordinates

```{r compare_coords}

st_crs(rev_station_sf2) == st_crs(bw_2023_locationsbays2)

coords_rev1 <- st_coordinates(rev_station_sf2)

coords_bw2023_1 <- st_coordinates(bw_2023_locationsbays2)

coordinates_are_equal <- isTRUE(all.equal(coords_rev1, coords_bw2023_1))

print(coordinates_are_equal)


matched_points <- st_join(rev_station_sf2, bw_2023_locationsbays2)

# code from script 02

# get closest neighbor of more recent stations to bw ID
distnn_rid1 = st_join(rev_station_sf2, bw_2023_locationsbays2, join = st_nn, k = 1, progress = FALSE)
class(distnn_rid1)
str(distnn_rid1)

# calculate distance to closest neighbor
dist_rid1 = st_nn(rev_station_sf2, bw_2023_locationsbays2,k = 1, returnDist = TRUE, progress = FALSE)
str(dist_rid1)
head(dist_rid1)

# this code goes to 2nd list, the distances, and pulls first element from that list
dists = sapply(dist_rid1[[2]], "[", 1)
dists

distnn_rid1$dist = dists

distnn_rid1
print(distnn_rid1, n = 53)
View(distnn_rid1)
# click show in window icon, which is next to the filter icon of distnn_or1 df tab. That dataframe window can be placed next to the synced maps so a match can be made between a station number and a monitoring location name.

```
